items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: The interviewee discusses Freddie Keppert only in response to the interviewer's statement ('He made one record with Freddie Keppert') and confirms the existence of the record but provides no personal interaction or relationship with Keppert himself.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a nice piano player. He went to Chicago, I think he died in Chicago too.
He made one record with Freddie Keppert.

That's right. He was on that record too. That's right, Arthur Campbell. And he was a good piano player. Now these fellas would play piano during those times. They had so many of them that I could name, but they wasn't the really top piano players. Now we had another piano player play good, a white boy played piano, was a very good piano player during that time. He was some kin to Shields, to Larry Shields, the trumpet player. Well they used to, I don't know if it was his cousin or what, but they used to live at…
